Subject:   Follow Up


President Waheed:



It was very good to catch up with you and your team for about an hour this evening.



I know that we just basically scratched the surface tonight with the number of things we need to
get underway for your successful election in September but we covered a good deal of ground
and your team had some very good questions as well as some contributions around operations
that they currently have underway as well as additional suggestions to the operations I covered -
All in all a good first discussion!!



As we concluded our discussions, we agreed that your team will work to gather the full and entire
listing of All Voters who Voted in the first Maldives Presidential Election AND find as many
contact Phone Numbers or Email Addresses as possible for those Voters which will allow us to be
able to get directly in contact with them.



I will begin developing a baseline polling instrument for your team to review and comment on
before we finalize in order to go into the field to develop as much baseline data for you and your
team as possible so that we can launch your candidacy with the maximum effectiveness.



I felt tonight was a good introduction and a good start. I also look forward to your feedback



McGee
